metadata.description: mitate — deterministic animated scenes from any input.

plugins.name: mitate
plugins.description: Turn any input — a document, a codebase, a mechanism, a joke — into a deterministic animated scene. Films of any register (explainer, game cutscene, meme, character short) authored on a single-file SQLite 3 Virtual Soundstage (shot.db), rendered by the native Apple Silicon Swift 6 + Metal 3/4 engine (mitate / slate CLI), and delivered as frame-exact MP4/ProRes 4444 or a self-contained HTML bundle (mitate bundle). 見立て: to see one thing as another.
